steps.description: Define the road trip route by specifying start, end, and key stops.
Fetch the coordinates for each location on the road trip route.
Calculate distances between consecutive stops along the route.
Recommend interesting places and scenic spots to visit along the route.
Search for budget-friendly restaurants along the road trip route.
Search for budget-friendly hotels along the road trip route.
Retrieve current exchange rates and currency symbols relevant to the trip locations.
Estimate and manage the total expenses for accommodation, food, and travel.
